Kit summary

Double Horizontal SlashBasicExclusive Lv.3
Deals 2 stages of DMG to a single enemy. The 1st stage deals [Bleed] DMG by 5% of Max HP; the 2nd stage deals [Internal Injury] DMG by 20% of Max HP and is guaranteed to inflict [Severe Wound] for 2 turns.
God of War's Axe Lv.3Increases the layer cap of [Ghost of Sparta] to 20 layers. When casting Double Horizontal Slash, steals 20% Mastery from the target for 3 turns, up to 200% Mastery can be gained in this way.
God of War's PrideActiveExclusive Lv.2
Grants [HP Up II] to all allies for 2 turns and [Catalyst of Chaos] to all allies excluding self for 2 turns. [Catalyst of Chaos]: When the owner deals DMG to enemies, Kratos steals 50% Mastery from the enemy who has dealt the highest DMG currently for 2 turns. Will be removed after it's triggered once.
God of War's Axe Lv.2Acts for 1 extra turn after casting God of War's Pride. Each time after stealing attributes, gains 1 layer of [War Spirit] (each layer increases self Basic Attack DMG by 20%, up to 10 layers), and increases Turn Meter by 20%. Once this effect is triggered, it can only be triggered again after God of War's Pride is cast again.
Power of SpartaPassive
Each time other allies steal attributes from enemies, Kratos pursues and attacks the target whose attributes are stolen once. Each enemy can only trigger this effect once during any turn. Each time Kratos steals attributes from enemies, he also gains [Ghost of Sparta]: Increases self Max HP by 5%, up to 10 layers.
Mighty AxeActiveExclusive Lv.1
Deals 2 stages of DMG to all enemies. The 1st stage deals [Bleed] DMG by 5% of Max HP; the 2nd stage deals [Internal Injury] DMG by 20% of Max HP and steals 40% Mastery from all enemies for 2 turns.
God of War's Axe Lv.1After each pursue-and-attack, also refreshes the duration of all buffs on self. Increases the duration of the stolen Mastery when casting Mighty Axe to 3 turns.
Source: game files.
